# GuardianForm Project Instructions

## Project Overview
GuardianForm is a React TypeScript web application for form submission that generates PDF documents with user-provided answers.

## Tech Stack
- React 18 with TypeScript
- Vite (build tool)
- React Hook Form (form management)
- jsPDF (PDF generation)
- React Router (navigation, if needed)

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components
- Implement form validation with React Hook Form
- Use jsPDF for PDF document generation
- Follow React best practices with hooks
- Keep components modular and reusable

## Key Features
- Form submission with validation
- PDF document generation from form data
- Responsive UI design
- Type-safe form handling
